map.：Content-Security-Policy 防 XSS、Strict-Tr: : Content-Security-Policy blocks XSS, Strict-Transport-Security enforces HTTPS, X-Content-Type-Options disables MIME sniffing and X-Frame-Options prevents clickjacking.

map.加固站点安全头：确认是否设置了 Content-Security-Policy、: Hardening a site's security headers: check that key response headers such as Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options and Strict-Transport-Security are set.
map.排查下载与编码问题：检查 Content-Type 与 Content-Disp: Debugging downloads and encoding: check whether Content-Type and Content-Disposition are correct — the first tells the browser how to interpret the response, the second whether to force a download and under what filename.
map.响应头能在前端 JS 里读取吗？: Can response headers be read from front-end JS?
map.同源请求可以读取大部分响应头；跨域请求默认只能拿到七个简单响应头（Cache-C: Same-origin requests can read most response headers; cross-origin requests expose only the simple response headers by default (Cache-Control, Content-Language, Content-Type, Expires, Last-Modified, Pragma and the like). To let the front end read a custom header (such as X-Request-Id), the server must list it explicitly in Access-Control-Expose-Headers on the preflight response.
map.为什么响应头改了不生效？: Why does a changed response header not take effect?
map.先确认改在哪一层：CDN 或反向代理可能缓存了旧响应头，源站已更新但边缘节点仍是: First confirm which layer you changed: a CDN or reverse proxy may have the old headers cached, with the origin already updated but the edge node still serving the stale copy — purge the CDN cache or wait for the TTL. Some headers (CSP, for instance) are cached by the browser too, so disable caching while testing.
